prog
mov r1 %bid
mov r2 %sm
mod r7 r2 4
sub r7 r7 3
brz r7 worker
mod r7 r2 2
mul r5 r1 41
mov r4 41
brnz r7 cg
ca:
mul r6 r5 193436
ld.ca r7 [r6+1048600]
sum.ca r0 [r6+1048576] 48359
add r3 r3 r0
atom.add r7 [64] 1
add r5 r5 1
sub r4 r4 1
brnz r4 ca
st [r1+128] r3
out r3
exit
cg:
mul r6 r5 193436
ld.ca r7 [r6+1048600]
sum.cg r0 [r6+1048576] 48359
add r3 r3 r0
atom.add r7 [64] 1
add r5 r5 1
sub r4 r4 1
brnz r4 cg
st [r1+128] r3
out r3
exit
watch:
ld.ca r7 [64]
spin.ca r6 [64] ge 1013
out r6
exit
worker:
mul r5 r1 17
mod r5 r5 300
add r5 r5 1276
mov r6 585428280
wloop:

st [r6+1048576] r1
sub r6 r6 66180
brnz r6 wloop
exit
